people.title: People you want to work with
people.lede: Experience, ideas and professional connections. Meet the people who build the industry.
people.experienceNote: Experience is described by the person and was not checked by the platform.
people.consentNote: The person decides what the page shows. A portrait is published only with consent.
people.experienceStaysBody: Your page, publications and professional history in one profile.

fieldHint.sales: On the manufacturers’ and suppliers’ side

people.worksCount: {count, plural, one {# work} other {# works}} in the portfolio
people.yearsCount: {count, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} in the industry
people.meetLede: Meet the participants, their roles and the published story of the project.
people.ctaTitle: A professional acquaintance starts with your page
people.ctaBody: Tell about yourself, keep what is useful and find people with shared interests.
people.aboutProfileBody: The page is published by the person: the portrait, contacts and workplace appear only with their consent. Experience is described by them; confirmations are marked separately.

personPage.selfDescribed: The description was written by the professional and was not checked by the platform.
personPage.servicesLede: What the professional offers. Prices on request: terms are discussed in correspondence inside the platform.
personPage.portfolioLede: Work the professional shows themselves. Work marked “Project on the platform” is linked to published projects.
personPage.projectsLede: Published projects where the person is listed as a participant.
personPage.publicationsLede: Articles and materials the person published on the platform.
personPage.documentsLede: What the person published themselves and what is confirmed. There are no scores or ratings.
personPage.consentItem: The page is published by its owner
personPage.portraitItem: The portrait is published with consent
personPage.employerItem: Membership in the company is confirmed by the company
personPage.employerNone: The workplace is not confirmed by the company
personPage.contactsLede: Public contacts, if the person opened them. A message inside the platform gets through in any case.
personPage.contactsEmpty: Contacts are not published. Write through the platform or ask the Agent.
personPage.isYouBody: Sign in to edit the description, statuses, services and portfolio.
personPage.reportIssue: Report a problem with the page
personPage.agentStatus: Answers from the page’s public data
personPage.agentHello: Hello! I am the Agent of {name}. I answer from what is published on the page: experience, services, portfolio, projects, statuses, contacts.
agentQuestions: Are they available for a project?
What experience do they have and where did they work?
How do I get in touch?

agent.services: {count, plural, one {Offers # service} other {Offers # services}}. Prices on request.
agent.servicesNone: Services are not published. You can write directly through the platform.
agent.portfolio: {count, plural, one {# work in the portfolio} other {# works in the portfolio}}:
agent.portfolioNone: The portfolio is not published yet.
agent.statusNone: No statuses set. Write through the platform and the person will answer themselves.
agent.contactsNone: No public contacts. A message inside the platform gets through after you sign in.
agent.projects: {count, plural, one {Takes part in # published project} other {Takes part in # published projects}}:
agent.fallback: That is not on the page. I can tell you about experience, services, portfolio, projects, statuses and contacts — or write to the person directly.

personPage.attachReceived: {count, plural, one {Received the file} other {Received # files}} {purpose}. The file is not published: only {name} sees it inside the platform.
personPage.attachNext: Sign in or create an account so the message gets through. The draft with the file is kept.
